---
name: Implementation question
about: Ask a focused question about applying SDAF in a real context
title: "[Implementation] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## SDAF version

Identify the version being used, for example `1.0`.

## Decision or use case

Briefly describe the architectural decision, assessment or implementation context.

## Relevant SDAF location

Identify the applicable Part, lifecycle phase, section, requirement, annex or template.

## System boundary

Describe the technology, service, infrastructure or organizational boundary relevant to the question.

## What has already been attempted

Explain how you have interpreted or applied SDAF so far.

## Specific question

State the precise point requiring clarification.

## Evidence and constraints

Describe relevant:

- available evidence;
- data limitations;
- uncertainty;
- legal or regulatory constraints;
- security or resilience requirements;
- commercial or operational constraints; and
- proportionality considerations.

## Expected outcome

Explain what decision, record or implementation activity the answer should support.

## Confidentiality check

- [ ] I have removed confidential, personal, security-sensitive and proprietary information.
- [ ] The example may be discussed publicly.
- [ ] Any organization or product names included are necessary and factually presented.

## Submission checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions for the same question.
- [ ] I identified the relevant SDAF version and location.
- [ ] I distinguished the question from a formal conformance claim.
